name: deg-det

leaves.name: degHomogPoly
leaves.doc: Mumford, Abelian varieties (1970), section 19 (locator UNVERIFIED; the statement used in the proof of 19 Thm 4): deg is a homogeneous polynomial function of degree 2g on End(X), X an abelian variety of dimension g over an algebraically closed field. Read in coordinates: for every finite family e_1..e_r in End(A) there is a homogeneous N in Q[x_1..x_r] of degree 2 dim A with degEnd(sum x_i e_i) = N(x) for all x in Z^r; degEnd is the genuine function-field degree (0 for non-isogenies).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (Mumford 19: deg is a homogeneous polynomial function of degree 2g on End X, from the theorem of the cube and Riemann-Roch); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Mumford, Abelian varieties, section 19 (deg is a homogeneous polynomial function of degree 2g on End(X)); also Milne, Abelian varieties (2008), section 12

leaves.name: sepDegKernel
leaves.doc: Mumford, Abelian varieties (1970), sections 4 and 7 (locators UNVERIFIED): for an isogeny psi of an abelian variety over an algebraically closed field k, ker psi is finite of order deg_s psi and deg_i psi is a power of the characteristic exponent. Stated as: the kernel of psi on the points over AlgebraicClosure k is finite and degEnd psi = #ker * (ringExpChar k)^e for some e.
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (Mumford 4/7: #ker = separable degree, inseparable degree a power of p); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Mumford, Abelian varieties, sections 4 and 7 (#ker f = deg_s f for an isogeny f; deg_i f a power of char k); also Milne, Abelian varieties (2008), section 7

note: deg-det: charPolyIndepOfEllAlgClosed (via charpoly-ell's DegEqDetTate) from two printed leaves (degHomogPoly: deg is a homogeneous polynomial function of degree 2g on End; sepDegKernel: deg = #ker * p^e) and the bundle's own fields mumfordTorsionAlgClosed and homFreeFiniteAlgClosed. Proved in Lean: the whole algebra of Mumford's proof of 19 Thm 4 (multiplicative polynomial functions on Z[phi] extended to Qbar_l[X]/(R) by the Combinatorial Nullstellensatz; det F(M) = prod F(roots); the l-adic comparison lemma), deg(psi chi) = deg psi deg chi (tower law), and |det T_l psi|_l = |#ker psi|_l for any endomorphism with finite kernel (Smith normal form over Z_l, finite levels, A[l^n] = (Z/l^n)^{2g}). Net count: -1 field +2 leaves, no glue (strict 34/11 -> 35/11). charpoly-ell's fold (one leaf DegEqDetTate) has the better count; this one replaces Mumford 19 Thm 4 by its two inputs. Report docs/research/deg-det.md.
